name: AC circuit breaker
summary: The device-function number identifying an AC circuit breaker.
description: Device function number 52 identifies an AC circuit breaker in the power-system device-function convention. It can appear in equipment identification, control references or a protection drawing, but it remains distinct from the graphical symbol and product specification.

On a power drawing, keep this function reference connected to the selected equipment and its complete designation. A multifunction relay can implement several numbered functions. This entry explains the reference; it supplies no settings or commissioning procedure.
readingNotes: Associate the number with the intended breaker equipment reference.
Read auxiliary-contact and control designations from the applicable documentation.
drawingChecklist: Reference auxiliary contacts and device documentation.
distinction: The number 52 identifies a device function. It is not an IEC graphical-symbol identifier, breaker current rating or manufacturer model.
